subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw add a supported cross-channel text acknowledgement contract before model dispatch, and should it be a `messages.ackText` config surface or a non-terminal plugin/channel hook?
rationale: The issue is valid from source inspection, but the fix adds new user-visible config or plugin API surface across messaging channels, which repository policy treats as a product and compatibility decision rather than a strict bug repair.

options.title: Design a shared ack-text contract
options.body: Add a generic, opt-in acknowledgement text surface with scope and channel/account overrides, then require docs and regression tests across the shared reply lifecycle.

options.title: Keep placeholders channel-owned
options.body: Leave this broad issue open as a tracker while Slack, Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, and Feishu solve their own placeholder lifecycles independently.

options.title: Decline text acknowledgements
options.body: Close the direction and rely on ack reactions, status reactions, typing indicators, and channel-specific streaming where supported.

recommendation.title: Design a shared ack-text contract
recommendation.body: Add a generic, opt-in acknowledgement text surface with scope and channel/account overrides, then require docs and regression tests across the shared reply lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has recent adjacent work on reply delivery and ack cleanup, and prior review context already routed this cross-channel lifecycle gap through that area.
